items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Up there was Nellie Carr, Twinkle Davis, Goldie Crosby, Lord have mercy, what's that other girl's name? Another girl and myself. ... And we was the hot shots, upstairs

ctx.x: And Sophie Tucker. Now, I'm getting ahead of myself. No, I'm going to stay there. The Panama. That's the Panama. We made a lot of money at the Panama. Twinkle Davis had the most beautiful limbs you ever saw. She reminded me so much of Marlene Dietrich, you know, now that I know what it's all about. Twinkle, she couldn't do anything but walk out on the floor, and that was all she had to do. She didn't have to do anything else. She was an attractive girl. She was good looking. But that's all she had, was her legs.…
So anyhow, Goldie Crosby could sing a little. Mamie Carter, she could sing a little, and then Nellie Carr used to do a dance and run and split, do the splits.
